R7BJ-moose-backcountry-0001.name: 3.4 km SW of Crow River
R7BJ-moose-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7BJ-moose-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 12 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 481.6 ha, right here.
Burn from 2021 (fire G91067), 50 m SE: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.cls: Spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls
seasonRows.notes: Bag 1. 7-43 portion only (LEH Synopsis map 7P, printed green); portion of 7-51 closed (Map H32); 7-52 portion only (LEH Synopsis map 7R)
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 134 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.83744, -124.40943, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 20 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 461 m, about 446 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 760 m NE of the spot at 522 m (59.83445, -124.75903). Water: unnamed wetland 90 m NE (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-53, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BJ-moose-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-53: about 130 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
